calculation.expression: (-return_20d / (std_return_20d * sqrt(252) + 0.05)) * clip(std_return_60d / (std_return_20d + eps), 0.5, 2.0), lagged one completed session
calculation.description: Ranks assets for medium-horizon contrarian recovery: negative recent 20-day return, risk scaled by short volatility, with higher score when recent volatility is below its 60-day baseline. Inputs and the complete signal are lagged one session to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2024 (IC 0.290887), 2027-2029 (0.131473), 2030 (0.216568), and 2031-2032 (0.108911); 2033-to-date is weak/slightly negative (-0.002411 over 23 observations), so recency drift requires monitoring. Cross-section is the complete 15-instrument benchmark and each valid date averaged 15 instruments.

admission.note: 60-day same-horizon paper IC/ICIR are used for this admission record; small cross-section uncertainty is addressed through 1693 dates and regime checks.
